tokens.npc_dota_hero_dawnbreaker_bio:
In the aeons after the Keeper's exodus birthed the age of light, some amongst the first sun's lineage began to align against the chaos their ancestor's maker left chasing in his wake. Calling themselves the Children of Light, they saw no one else as worthy of taking up the Keeper's abandoned mantle, and they yearned to beat back the onslaught of darkness, creating glorious armies built to purge the cosmos of all creatures of primordial night.

Valora, the Dawnbreaker, most prized warrior amongst the Children's ancient creations, is the shining herald of the majesty of order and light. Molded from the heart of a young metallic star, and charged by golden breath with new life, Valora was called to spread the glow of the Children's wisdom to the darkest reaches of the universe — setting fire to the heavens with each swing of her celestial hammer amidst an endless battle to keep chaos at bay.

In time, the Children also revealed another purpose for the Dawnbreaker. They had discovered a means of permeating the entirety of the cosmos with their inner light — to obliterate all aspects of darkness forever — and they sent Valora to seize a source of great power, the final piece of their ultimate plan. But for the first time, Valora and her hammer met with failure, and the price she and her masters paid was vast. The Children of Light's spark was utterly extinguished, and the Dawnbreaker was left adrift in a black expanse, lost for untold millennia before crashing on an unfamiliar world.

There she rested, dormant, until the presence of a wandering young star gave fuel to an ancient energy forge — a relic of the Children's that, like her, lay buried for countless ages beneath a blowing red waste. Now, with a small measure of her former powers restored by the forge, Valora wakes to a land beset by war and the unrelenting forces of chaos. She knows her gods may be gone, but the heft of the Dawnbreaker's hammer remains — matched only by her will to wield it justly in the name of goodness and light.

She revels in hurling her hammer through multiple foes and then converging with it in a blazing wake, always waiting to tap her true cosmic power to fly to the aid of her teammates — eager to rout her enemies on the battlefield no matter where they are.

* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}}
*** [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Targeting Visualized icon-1.png|84px|Starbreaker Ability-Targeting Effects Visualized]][[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Targeting Visualized icon-2.png|84px|Starbreaker Ability-Targeting Effects Visualized]]
*** Has a custom area-targeting indicator for both the swipe and smash attack components visualized as above.
** {{Symbol|Target|Ground}}
*** {{M|Doubletap}} considers ground-targeting the ability {{Code|25-distance}} in front of Dawnbreaker's current {{M|facing angle}}.

* Has the following ability cast limitations:
** [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker (Inactive) icon.png|21px|Inactive]]
*** Inactive in the following conditions:
**** While the current Starbreaker instance is still active.
**** While not wielding her weapon after {{A|Dawnbreaker|Celestial Hammer}} cast.
**** While {{M|channeling}} {{A|Dawnbreaker|Solar Guardian}}.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Cannot cast the following Dawnbreaker-based abilities while the current Starbreaker instance is still active.
**** {{A|Dawnbreaker|Celestial Hammer}}
**** {{A|Dawnbreaker|Solar Guardian}}

* This ability has four main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** The {{#var:Starbreaker value3}}-second combo consists of three components of the following sequence:
**** [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Swipe.png|31px|Starbreaker Swipe]] Swipe {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Swipe.png|31px|Starbreaker Swipe]] Swipe {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Smash.png|31px|Starbreaker Smash]] Smash
*** Applies the following ability effects on Dawnbreaker during the [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Swipe.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Swipe.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Smash.png|21px]] combo:
**** {{M|Disarm}}
**** [[Set Movement Speed|Sets]] her {{M|movement speed}} to {{#var:Starbreaker type3 value2 shd}}.
**** {{Symbol|Forced Movement}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}}
***** Applies a self-[[forced movement]] toward the area-targeted direction, and moves Dawnbreaker a total {{Code|{{#expr:{{#var:Starbreaker type3 value2 shd}}*{{#var:Starbreaker value3}}}}-distance}} over the entire combo duration.
***** Can be moved through {{M|buildings}} while active.
***** The forced movement component applied can only be paused in the following conditions:
****** While affected by other {{M|disabling}} {{M|forced movement}} sources.
****** The movement path is blocked by the following sources:
******* {{M|Impassable terrain}}.
******* {{M|Temporary fence}} sources.
******* {{M|Pathing blocker}} sources.
***** {{Symbol|Turn Rate|Lock}} {{Symbol|fx|v}}
****** Locks her {{M|facing angle}}, regardless of the ability animations.
****** Can only cast {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} targeted abilities in the direction she is facing.
***** {{Symbol|Trees}}
****** [[Trees]] within 100-radius centered around Dawnbreaker are destroyed while being moved.
*** The following {{M|disable}} sources interrupts the Starbreaker combo:
**** {{M|Cyclone}} sources.
**** {{M|Fear}} sources.
**** {{M|Hex}} sources.
**** {{M|Taunt}} sources.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Swipe.png|21px]] + [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Smash.png|21px]]
*** Applies an [[instant attack]] instance per {{#expr:{{#var:Starbreaker value3}}/({{#var:Starbreaker basic1}}+{{#var:Starbreaker basic2}}-1) round2}}-second intervals during the combo, over {{#expr:{{#var:Starbreaker basic1}}+{{#var:Starbreaker basic2}}}} instances, with the following properties:
**** Procs any {{M|attack modifiers}} and {{M|on-cast effects}} as per normal, except {{M|cleave}} sources.
***** Grants 1 {{A|Dawnbreaker|Luminosity}} charge per instant attack instance, regardless of how many enemy units are affected per instance.
**** Have {{M|True Strike}}.
**** Not affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
**** Does not affect the following units:
***** {{M|Couriers}}
*** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
**** All affected enemy units are damaged at the same time per interval regardless of the ability animations.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|21px|3]]
*** [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Swipe.png|42px]] {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** The first {{#var:Starbreaker type1 value1}} swipe instance applies the {{M|movement speed}} slow within the instant attack radius.
*** [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Smash.png|42px]]
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
***** The final smash instance is applied within {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Starbreaker type2 value2}} radius centered around and {{#var:Starbreaker type2 value3}}-distance in front of Dawnbreaker.
***** Applies a {{M|stun}} with a 90-distance {{M|upward movement}}.
***** Affects enemy units up to {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Starbreaker type2 value2}}+{{#var:Starbreaker type2 value3}}}} range away with the smash radius and smash distance.
**** {{Symbol|Stun}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
***** After the smash instance, Starbreaker applies a {{#var:Starbreaker type2 value6}}-second self-stun duration.
***** Affects Dawnbreaker even while she is {{M|hidden}} or {{M|invulnerable}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-4.png|21px|4]]
*** {{cf|shdnotes}} Now additionally applies the following ability effects on Dawnbreaker during the [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Swipe.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Swipe.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Dawnbreaker Starbreaker Smash.png|21px]] combo:
**** {{M|Debuff immunity}}.
**** Stacks multiplicatively with other {{M|magic resistance}} sources.
**** Sets her [[min movement speed]] to {{ValueColor||{{#var:Starbreaker type3 value2 shd}}|shd}} over the entire combo duration.
***** Other {{M|movement speed}} sources affect Dawnbreaker as per normal.
***** The moved distance is now defined as:
****** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|MovedDistance {{=}} Current[[Movement Speed|MS]] × {{ValueColor||{{#expr:1-{{#explode:{{#var:Starbreaker type3 value3 shd}}|%}}/100}}|shd|x}} × {{#var:Starbreaker value3}}}}
**** No longer applies a self-{{M|forced movement}}. Hence, Dawnbreaker cannot pass through {{M|buildings}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-5.png|21px|5]]

* {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Tally}}
** The [[required attacks]] tally increases by 1 per successful attack on an enemy unit.
*** This includes both {{M|instant attack}} and {{M|secondary attack}} sources.
** Attacking the following units do not increase the tally counter:
*** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
*** {{M|Buildings}}
*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}}
*** Once the tally counter reaches {{Symbol|Tally|{{#expr:{{#var:Luminosity value1}}-1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{Symbol|Tally|{{#expr:{{#var:Luminosity value1 tal}}-1}}tal}}), the next successful attack procs all ability effects centered around Dawnbreaker, and the tally buff is removed.
*** The tally buff has the following properties:
**** When the counter is ≤ {{Symbol|Tally|{{#expr:{{#var:Luminosity value1}}-2}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{Symbol|Tally|{{#expr:{{#var:Luminosity value1 tal}}-2}}tal}}), it lasts indefinitely and persists through {{M|death}}.
**** When the counter is ≤ {{Symbol|Tally|{{#expr:{{#var:Luminosity value1}}-1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{Symbol|Tally|{{#expr:{{#var:Luminosity value1 tal}}-1}}tal}}), it resets in the following conditions:
***** Upon {{M|death|x}}, including {{M|reincarnation}} sources.
***** Leveling up Luminosity.

* {{Symbol|Critical Strike}}
** Luminosity is an ensured [[critical strike]] source.
** Sources with lesser critical values have no effect if they proc as the higher factor takes precedence.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** The ability effects are applied as follows:
**# Dawnbreaker {{M|lifesteals}} based on the {{M|critical strike}} damage ([[after reductions]]).
**# {{M|Heals}} allied units within the radius for {{#var:Luminosity value5}} based on the {{M|critical strike}} value.
**# The {{M|required attacks}} buff resets to 0. 

* Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.

* {{Symbol|bonus ls}}
** Stacks additively with other [[lifesteal]] sources.
** {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}} {{Symbol|bonus hprestore}}
*** The ally [[heal]] value corresponds to the lifesteal value. Hence, [[lifesteal manipulation]] sources indirectly affect the heal value.

* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|Area}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
*** [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-6-1.png|105px|Solar Guardian Ability-Targeting Effects Visualized]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-6-2.png|105px|Solar Guardian Ability-Targeting Effects Visualized]]
*** Has a custom area-targeting indicator visualized as above.
**** Searches for the nearest valid allied hero to {{M|teleport}} toward within {{Code|{{#var:Solar Guardian type1 value1}}-distance}} of the area-targeted location.
**** {{M|Doubletap}} now targets the cursor's current location.
**** The indicator considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
***** Circle [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] indicates the max teleport distance toward allied unit [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]].
***** Point [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] has to be within the [[Wikipedia:Circumference|circumference]] of Circle [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] , this will be Solar Guardian's landing location.
****** {{Code|OP {{=}} {{#var:Solar Guardian type1 value2}}}}
** {{Symbol|Target|Portrait}}
*** [[Portrait-casting]] automatically targets Dawnbreaker's current location.

* Cannot be cast under the following conditions:
** Without allied heroes within the {{#var:Solar Guardian type1 value1}}-search distance.
** While {{A|Dawnbreaker|Starbreaker}} is active.

* Solar Guardian does not follow the allied hero once the target destination is locked-in.

* Causes a {{#var:Solar Guardian value6}} second temporary {{M|daytime}} when the cast starts.

* The ability has four main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]]
*** [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-6-1.png|105px|Solar Guardian Ability-Targeting Effects Visualized]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-6-2.png|105px|Solar Guardian Ability-Targeting Effects Visualized]]
**** Creates an {{M|aura}} that pulses in {{#var:Solar Guardian value4}}-second intervals at the landing location [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]], starting immediately upon cast, over {{#var:Solar Guardian value5}} instances until Dawnbreaker lands.
***** {{cf|aghnotes}} And then over {{ValueColor||{{#var:Solar Guardian type4 value2 agh}}|agh}} instances after landing, centered around Dawnbreaker.
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
***** For Dawnbreaker, the ability effects does not apply to her even if she's within the landing radius.
**** Applies the following ability effects within the landing radius:
***** {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
****** {{M|Heal}}
***** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
****** The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
***** All ability components do not affect the following units:
****** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
****** {{M|Hidden}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]]
*** {{Symbol|Channeling}}
**** {{M|Cannot act}} while [[channeling]] and can only be interrupted by offensive [[disable]] sources.
**** Dawnbreaker is unable to manually cancel the channeling.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Channeling|t}}
**** Applies the following ability effects on herself once the channeling succeeds:
***** {{M|Disarm}}
***** {{M|Hidden}} without {{M|invulnerability}} applied.
***** {{M|Spell immune}}, without {{M|basic dispel}} applied.
***** {{M|Untargetable|text=Unselectability}}
***** {{#expr:{{#var:Solar Guardian type1 value4}}/2}} seconds after the channeling succeeds:
****** [[Upward Movement|Ascends]] and reaches its highest altitude ≈2500 ({{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{ValueColor||≈7500|agh}})-distance up on the z-axis.
****** Dawnbreaker {{M|teleports}} towards the center of the landing radius.
**** At this state, Solar Guardian can no longer be interrupted.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|21px|3]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
*** Towards the end of the flight duration, she descends onto the ground and applies all the landing ability effects centered around Dawnbreaker's hero model.
*** All ability effects continue at Dawnbreaker's {{M|death}} location once the channeling succeeds.
*** {{Symbol|Trees}}
**** [[Trees]] within 350-radius centered around Dawnbreaker are destroyed.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-4.png|21px|4]] {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*** Plays a 0.5-second ability animation upon landing.

* {{Symbol|Teleport}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** The flight can be interrupted by other [[teleport]] sources.
** When interrupted this way, the ability effects are still applied at landing radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]]. However, Dawnbreaker is not teleported to the landing radius.
** The {{M|stun}} component is then applied at Dawnbreaker's current location.

data.bio_loc:
In the aeons after the Keeper's exodus birthed the age of light, some amongst the first sun's lineage began to align against the chaos their ancestor's maker left chasing in his wake. Calling themselves the Children of Light, they saw no one else as worthy of taking up the Keeper's abandoned mantle, and they yearned to beat back the onslaught of darkness, creating glorious armies built to purge the cosmos of all creatures of primordial night.

Valora, the Dawnbreaker, most prized warrior amongst the Children's ancient creations, is the shining herald of the majesty of order and light. Molded from the heart of a young metallic star, and charged by golden breath with new life, Valora was called to spread the glow of the Children's wisdom to the darkest reaches of the universe — setting fire to the heavens with each swing of her celestial hammer amidst an endless battle to keep chaos at bay.

In time, the Children also revealed another purpose for the Dawnbreaker. They had discovered a means of permeating the entirety of the cosmos with their inner light — to obliterate all aspects of darkness forever — and they sent Valora to seize a source of great power, the final piece of their ultimate plan. But for the first time, Valora and her hammer met with failure, and the price she and her masters paid was vast. The Children of Light's spark was utterly extinguished, and the Dawnbreaker was left adrift in a black expanse, lost for untold millennia before crashing on an unfamiliar world.

There she rested, dormant, until the presence of a wandering young star gave fuel to an ancient energy forge — a relic of the Children's that, like her, lay buried for countless ages beneath a blowing red waste. Now, with a small measure of her former powers restored by the forge, Valora wakes to a land beset by war and the unrelenting forces of chaos. She knows her gods may be gone, but the heft of the Dawnbreaker's hammer remains — matched only by her will to wield it justly in the name of goodness and light.
data.hype_loc: Dawnbreaker shines in the heart of battle, happily crushing enemies with her celestial hammer and healing nearby allies. She revels in hurling her hammer through multiple foes and then converging with it in a blazing wake, always waiting to tap her true cosmic power to fly to the aid of her teammates — eager to rout her enemies on the battlefield no matter where they are.

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_fire_wreath
abilities.desc_loc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
abilities.lore_loc: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organize defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.
notes_loc: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of %movement_speed% for the duration of the ability and takes a brief %self_stun_duration%s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by %swipe_slow%%% for %sweep_stun_duration%s.
abilities.shard_loc: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
facets_loc: Dawnbreaker and her allies in a %movespeed_bonus_radius% radius gain attack speed for %movespeed_bonus_duration% seconds at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer
abilities.desc_loc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
abilities.lore_loc: The Brightmaul is Valora's oldest companion and sole remaining connection to the glow of her creators.
notes_loc: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
facets_loc: When Celestial Hammer lands on the ground, it creates the healing and damaging effects of Solar Guardian, reduced by %hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%% in a %hammer_solar_guardian_radius% AoE around it. Increases the duration that the hammer can remain stationary to %pause_duration%s.
Allied heroes walking on Celestial Hammer's fire trail gain bonus movement speed.

abilities.desc_loc: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
abilities.lore_loc: Diminished in power without access to the Children's replenishing light, Valora can still recharge herself and her allies by creating order from the chaos which resides within each fight.
notes_loc: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
abilities.scepter_loc: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
facets_loc: Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
abilities.scepter_loc: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.
